description.text: The second Diamond & Pearl set, released in August 2007 with 124 cards, 123 numbered and a secret Time-Space Distortion, the first secret card since EX Holon Phantoms, and two theme decks, Armor Fortress and Skull Charge. It brought in the lake guardians Uxie, Mesprit and Azelf and the new Fossil Pokémon Rampardos and Bastiodon, each the star of a theme deck, and Pokémon holding Berries, whose held item works like a Poké-Body. Its reverse holos took a new holo pattern.
